svg.aria-label: A uses three constructed basis curves to explain mixing; B shows the fit and residual, in units of 10³ deg cm² dmol⁻¹. C changes the low-wavelength cutoff, with error bars of twice the SD from 160 specified-noise resamples. D changes only the assumed concentration. Dotted lines mark prescribed fractions; reference-library uncertainty is not part of these teaching calculations.
